stories.title: ‘Elon is my prophet’: how Musk’s Doge team took a wrecking ball to Washington
stories.summary: A Guardian report examines how Elon Musk’s Department of Government Efficiency sent young technology staff into US federal agencies to disrupt their operations. It focuses on resistance from a federal worker who sought to protect immigrant data after an email was sent to the entire federal workforce in February 2025.
